First Brother |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[9 ABY]],{{AhsokaSeriesDate}} [[Seatos]]{{Ahsoka|Part Four: Fallen Jedi}} |species=[[Humanoid]]{{Ahsoka|Part Two: Toil and Trouble}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{Databank|marrok-inquisitor|Marrok (Inquisitor)}} |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin= |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Jedi Order]]''[[Star Wars: The Secrets of the Sith]]'' states that the [[Inquisitor]]s were all former Jedi. *[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Inquisitorius]] *[[Morgan Elsbeth's forces]]{{Ahsoka|Part One: Master and Apprentice}} {{C|as a [[mercenary]]}} |masters=[[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]{{TOTE|Devoted}} |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Marrok will complete his task.|Baylan Skoll, to Morgan Elsbeth|}} '''Marrok''', known at one [[time]] as the '''First Brother''', was a mysterious [[Force-sensitive]] [[humanoid]] warrior who once served in the [[Inquisitorius]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], and the [[Jedi Order]] before that. After the [[Imperial Era]], the former [[Inquisitor]] was hired by the [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]] as a [[mercenary]]. During his [[time]] in [[Morgan Elsbeth's forces]], Marrok worked with other [[The Force|Force]]-sensitive mercenaries—former [[Jedi General|General]] [[Baylan Skoll]] of the [[Jedi Order]], and his apprentice [[Shin Hati]]. Around the [[Standard year|year]] [[9 ABY]] of the [[New Republic Era]], Marrok aided Elsbeth in her [[Quest to find Ezra Bridger|quest]] to find [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]]. The former Inquisitor engaged [[Ahsoka Tano]], a former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]], in a [[lightsaber duel]] during a [[Mission to Corellia (New Republic)|mission]] on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]]. They [[Incident on Seatos|confronted]] each other once more on [[Seatos]], where the former [[Jedi hunter]] was struck down by Tano's [[Ahsoka Tano's white lightsabers|blade]]. Despite Marrok's fall, Tano and her Padawan [[Sabine Wren]] failed to prevent Elsbeth's journey to the [[Far galaxy|distant galaxy]] where Thrawn was [[Exile (punishment)|exiled]]. ==Biography== ===Imperial Inquisitor=== {{Quote|Brothers, sisters. Enter.''"
[Marrok and the others enter, all kneel]
"''Now it is time you meet your new master.|The Grand Inquisitor introduces Marrok and his fellow Inquisitors to Darth Vader|}} [[File:Marrok-SWAhsoka.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Marrok was once an Inquisitor who served the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era.]] Marrok was a [[Gender|male]] [[humanoid]] who was raised as a member of the [[Jedi Order]].''[[Star Wars: The Secrets of the Sith]]'' states that the [[Inquisitor]]s were all former Jedi. With a few exceptions,''[[Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade]]'' [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]] had ordered the [[Order 66|death]] of all [[Jedi]] at the [[Mission to Mustafar|end]] of the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]{{Film|III}} in [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' paving the way for his Empire. Whilst highly effective, Order 66 did not eliminate every member of the [[Jedi Order]] outright, forcing Sidious to deploy''[[Star Wars: The Secrets of the Sith]]'' his long planned [[Inquisitorius]] program to continue the [[Great Jedi Purge]].[[Darth Vader (2017) 6|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 6]] Marrok was one individual selected to join the [[Galactic Empire]] as an Inquisitor, where he was given the designation of First Brother, tasked with hunting down surviving Jedi during the [[Imperial Era]]. Shortly into the Imperial Era in 19 BBY,"[[Devoted]]" takes place during and immediately after [[Operation: Knightfall]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. Marrok was present on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[ocean]] [[moon]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' [[Nur]] within the under-construction [[Fortress Inquisitorius]], where he was joined by [[the Grand Inquisitor]]—the highest ranking member of the Inquisitorius itself—and several other Inquisitors, including the former Jedi [[Barriss Offee]], the [[Fourth Sister]], and the [[Eleventh Brother]]. One stormy day, after Offee's training was complete, Marrok and his fellow Inquisitors were invited by the Grand Inquisitor to enter the audience chamber,{{TOTE|Devoted}} {{AD|Disney+}} passing several [[Purge Trooper]]s—[[clone trooper]]s who served the Inquisitorius as expendable [[death]] [[squad]]s[[Darth Vader (2017) 16|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 16]]—as they entered. With all three joining Offee and forming a line before the Grand Inquisitor, who gave a nod to those gathered, Marrok was the second to kneel after the Eleventh Brother. [[File:FirstBrotherEleventhBrotherKneel-Devoted.png|thumb|left|300px|Marrok and Eleventh Brother were the first to kneel in preparation for the arrival of Darth Vader, leader of the Inquisitorius.]] Once all four kneeled, the Grand Inquisitor decreed it was time for the four to meet their new master: the [[Sith]] [[Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], the [[Sith apprentice]] to Sidious, a teacher to the Inquisitors, and the leader of the Inquisitorius as per the power granted to him by Sidious.''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' Once Vader sat atop a throne on the room's dais with even the Grand Inquisitor kneeling, the Grand Inquisitor stood and invited his comrades to do the same, recognizing them as Inquisitors. Marrok was the second to finishing rising after the Eleventh Brother and stood silently as the Grand Inquisitor and Offee engaged in the chant "[[Long live the Empire]]." As an Inquisitor, Marrok carried out his organization's directive to hunt and destroy the Jedi for the Empire and the Sith. Through the Inquisitorius' efforts, the number of Jedi survivors decreased over the course of Sidious' reign as [[Galactic Emperor]]. However, as a result of their own success, the Inquisitors were deemed obsolete by Sidious who viewed them as an expendable force. The Empire ultimately [[Battle of Jakku|fell]] to the [[New Republic]] after the deaths of Sidious and Vader during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. ===Morgan Elsbeth's mercenary=== ====Searching for the map to Peridea==== {{Quote|Either the Jedi has the map or it was vaporized.''"
"''She has it.|Baylan Skoll and Morgan Elsbeth, after Skoll and Marrok had searched the ruins|}} [[File:Elsbeth_in_Arcana.jpg|thumb|300px|Marrok and Skoll stride through the Arcana ruins towards Elsbeth.]] Marrok was active during the [[New Republic Era]]. By [[9 ABY]], the Inquisitor had been hired as a [[mercenary]] by Imperial collaborator [[Morgan Elsbeth]] and worked as a member of her [[Morgan Elsbeth's forces|forces]].{{Ahsoka|Part Three: Time to Fly}} As part of her hopes to restore her culture{{Ahsoka|Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord}} and hoping to rebuild the Empire, Elsbeth, a surviving [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] from the Outer Rim planet [[Dathomir]] who had become a vital part of the [[Imperial Military|Imperial war machine]] through her work in manufacturing, plotted to return [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] "Thrawn"—who was trapped in [[Exile (punishment)|exile]] on the [[extragalactic]] planet [[Peridea]] in a [[Far galaxy|far away galaxy]]—back to the galaxy itself to restore the Imperial regime and wage [[Campaign against Thrawn's forces|war with the New Republic]].{{Ahsoka|Part Six: Far, Far Away}} Along with Thrawn, she hoped to bring the Nightsister [[Great Mothers]], who had allied with Thrawn and called out to Elsbeth in the first place, back from Peridea and into the galaxy proper. Marrok helped in Elsbeth's quest to locate Thrawn, whose exact location she did not yet know. After Elsbeth was [[Liberation of Calodan|captured]] by the former [[Jedi]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] and handed over to the New Republic, she would be [[Attack on the Vesper|rescued]] by two other Force-sensitive mercenaries in her employ, former [[Jedi General]] [[Baylan Skoll]] and his apprentice [[Shin Hati]]. Following her rescue, Elsbeth, Hati, and Skoll ventured to the planet [[Arcana]] in the Outer Rim. Elsbeth had learned Arcana was the hiding place of a [[Arcana Star Map|star map]] that contained the path to Peridea. Marrok accompanied Skoll, Hati, and Elsbeth to Arcana, where Elsbeth's [[HK-87 assassin droid]]s had tried to claim the map but had been defeated by Tano. Tano herself had escaped with the map despite those [[assassin droid]]s activating a [[self-destruct mechanism]] in a last ditch effort to stop Tano, destroying the [[Nightsisters' Temple|Nightsister stronghold]] that had once contained the [[star map]]. Marrok and Skoll searched over the ruins but found no trace of the map. Upon returning to Elsbeth, Skoll suggested that it was either been taken already by Tano or vaporised in the explosion that occurred. Elsbeth responded that Tano's apprentice [[Sabine Wren]] was in possession of it, before ordering Skoll to send Hati to [[Lothal]] to retrieve it. Marrok watched as Elsbeth walked away. Skoll explained the situation and mission to Hati, who questioned Elsbeths intentions, before the latter walked off to journey to Lothal. Marrok then approached Skoll, before the two followed Elsbeth. ====Duel on Corellia==== {{Quote|Go to Corellia. Assist Marrok with the final transport.''"
"''Yes, Master.|Baylan Skoll and Shin Hati|}} [[File:MarrokConfrontsAshoka-Ahsoka2.png|thumb|left|250px|Marrok challenged Ahsoka Tano to a duel while his allies secured a hyperdrive core for the ''Eye of Sion''.]] Whilst Hati retrieved the star [[map]], Marrok was sent on a [[Mission to Corellia (New Republic)|mission]] to [[Corellia]] to steal a [[Super Star Destroyer]]'s [[hyperdrive]] core for Elsbeth's [[hyperspace transport ring]], the ''[[Eye of Sion]]''. Tano and [[General]] [[Hera Syndulla]] tried to prevent the hyperdrive core's theft, forcing Marrok to confront Tano directly while Elsbeth's forces absconded with the hyperdrive unit on [[Transport CT-O5]]. In what was to be their first encounter,{{InsiderCite|222|Launchpad}} Marrok fought against the former Jedi in a breathtaking [[lightsaber duel]], in which he used his [[Color|red]] [[double-bladed spinning lightsaber]] against [[Ahsoka Tano's white lightsabers|Tano's white lightsabers]]. An [[HK-87 assassin droid]] fought alongside Marrok until the [[droid]] was destroyed by Tano. Marrok continued the duel despite the loss of his [[assassin droid]], activating the second [[plasma]] blade of his [[lightsaber]]. The confrontation was captured by the shipyards' security cameras.''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' Marrok disengaged from their duel after his allies succeeded in leaving the [[Facility 301G|facility]] at the [[Santhe Shipyards|Corellian shipyard]] with the hyperdrive core. By then, Hati arrived with her [[Baylan's shuttle|master's]] [[Eta-class shuttle|''Eta''-class shuttle]] to retrieve Marrok. She used the [[shuttle]]'s weapons to slow Tano down, allowing Marrok to reach the vessel before the Jedi could catch up to him. ====Pursuit above Seatos==== {{Quote|She's on the wing.''"
"''I see her.|Marrok and Shin Hati, on Ahsoka Tano|}} [[File:DogfightDenabSystem.png|thumb|right|250px|Marrok and Shin Hati led the starfighter attack on Tano near Seatos .]] With Syndulla's help, Tano and Wren tracked the [[transport]] to the [[Denab system]]. Elsbeth dispatched a starfighter squadron led by Hati and Marrok to destroy Tano's [[T-6 1974|T-6 shuttle]]. Although a few of their [[scout guard]]s were killed during the [[Dogfight in the Denab system|dogfight]] in [[Realspace|space]], Tano's [[starship]] was damaged and forced to land on the planet [[Seatos]]. ====Like dust in the wind==== {{Quote|The guards will not delay them long.''"
"''But you will.|Morgan Elsbeth, to Baylan Skoll, and Baylan Skoll, to Shin Hati and Marrok|}} [[File:PartFour-FallenJedi.png|thumb|left|250px|Marrok and Tano battled each other a final time in the forests of Seatos.]] With the ''Eye of Sion'' in the process of downloading the star map's coordinates to Peridea, Elsbeth and Skoll dispatched their [[scout guard]]s into a [[forest]] on Seatos where Tano and Wren had landed their shuttle. Knowing that the guards would not survive for long against a Jedi, Skoll ordered Hati to confront Tano and her Mandalorian apprentice. Marrok accompanied Hati into the forest where they obstructed Tano and Wren's path to the star map. While Wren and Hati fought, Tano and Marrok ignited their lightsabers and paced in a circle before engaging. Following an exchange of strikes, Marrok spun his blades across the circular hilt, preparing for an attack. As the two stepped forward, Tano slashed a large cut through Marrok's [[armor]]. A cloud of dark green mist erupted from the wound followed by a piercing shriek as Marrok's armor fell to the ground while he joined his fallen brothers and sisters. ===Sands of history=== {{Quote|Given that the exact number of Inquisitors is still undetermined, we cannot be sure if any survived the fall of the Empire. However, security recordings of an encounter at the Santhe Shipyards on Corellia attended by General Hera Syndulla of the New Republic and Ahsoka Tano—previously a Jedi herself—show an individual who appeared to be an Inquisitor, despite it taking place some years after the end of the Galactic Civil War.|Beaumont Kin, ''The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire''|}} [[File:TROS-SayTheLine.png|thumb|right|250px|The historian Beaumont Kin (pictured) was unable to confirm Marrok's identity in the decades after the Thrawn stratagem.]] The security recordings of Marrok's encounter with Ahsoka Tano on Corellia in 9 ABY''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' were categorized into the Corellia-specific section of the [[New Republic Archives]], where the recordings were filed into the "Morgan Elsbeth Conspiracy" file. Those recordings in the New Republic Archives were later reviewed by the [[historian]] [[Beaumont Kin]], a scholar of the Sith Order who took time to study the rise and fall of the Empire in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Exegol]] of [[35 ABY]]. Kin's research included a study into the Inquisitorius, yet he''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' did not know of Marrok by name; after studying Marrok's duel in the Corellian recordings, Kin remained unsure if the figure was a real Inquisitor or simply someone in Inquisitor-derived gear. Kin reflected Marrok's duel against Tano and his uncertainly as to Marrok's identity in his book ''[[The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' published in 35 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]].{{RiseAndFallDate}} Kin confessed it was possible Marrok was a surviving Inquisitor, as there was no known record as to how many individuals had served in the group's ranks, but also made mention of how many years had passed between the end of the Galactic Civil War and Marrok's appearance on Corellia, which he felt cast doubt on the veracity of Marrok's station. [[File:CorelliaDuel9ABY-AtlasUpdated.png|thumb|left|300px|Marrok's duel against Ahsoka Tano in 9 ABY was depicted in the art of Gammit Chond, whose work was later published to the wider galaxy by the Graf Archive.]] However, Marrok was known by name to the famous [[Ithorian]] [[artist]] [[Gammit Chond]], who was also aware of Marrok's duel against Ahsoka Tano on Corellia. For his maps of Corellia, Chond used his knowledge of the event to compose a piece depicting the duel on Corellia featuring Marrok, Tano, and Marrok's HK-87 assassin droid companion. Chond's notes and artwork would later find their way into the [[Shadow Stacks]] of the [[Graf Archive]] on the [[moon]] [[Orchis 2]]. After the Archive's discovery and publication of many of Chond's pieces as the ''[[Galactic Atlas]]''{{GermanFanCite|96|Database}} at some point during or after the year [[34 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' more of the artist's notes and artwork, including those related to Marrok and the greater Thrawn stratagem of 9 ABY, were discovered deep in the Shadow Stacks by archivist [[Tollan Magzax]]. Those newly discovered works were processed and released to the galaxy in an updated version of ''Galactic Atlas'', which was published during or after 35 ABY. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Marrok, form up on my wing and wait for my signal.''"
"''As you wish.|Shin Hati and Marrok|}} Marrok was a mysterious warrior who once hunted Jedi in service to the Galactic Empire. After the Empire's fall, the ex-Inquisitor became a hired mercenary who carried out "dark deeds" for Morgan Elsbeth. Marrok followed his orders and traveled to where he was sent; Baylan Skoll was confident in Marrok's ability to complete his task, having vouched for him to Elsbeth. Marrok also complied with Shin Hati's orders while serving under her command in the Denab [[Star system|system]]. As a warrior, Marrok challenged Ahsoka Tano to a duel on two occasions, first with the help of an [[assassin]] droid on Corellia, and then alone on Seatos, where he ultimately lost to the former Jedi. Marrok's body was completely encased by his armor, with a green mist exploding out of the slice in the armor caused by Tano's lightsaber. ==Powers and abilities== Marrok was [[The Force|Force]]-sensitive and skilled in [[lightsaber combat]], able to fight Ahsoka Tano on even footing. The former Inquisitor possessed [[Force power]]s such as [[telekinesis]], which Marrok used when he pulled his lightsaber back to his hand after throwing it at Tano. He also was an adept [[pilot]], capable of navigating through a swarm of [[purrgil]]. As an Inquisitor, Marrok was experienced in hunting Jedi. ==Equipment== {{Quote|An emitter ring surrounded the hilt, allowing the opposing blades to rotate at high speeds, greatly increasing their ability to deal death and destruction.|Darth Sidious, on the typical Inquisitor lightsaber|}} [[File:Marrok-CGSWG.png|thumb|right|300px|Marrok was an armored warrior who wielded a double-bladed spinning lightsaber.]] [[Marrok's lightsaber]] was a [[Double-bladed lightsaber|double-bladed]] spinning lightsaber, also known as an Inquisitor lightsaber,''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' that featured red plasma blades on either end of its circular hilt. The Inquisitor lightsaber was specifically designed to increase the wielder's lethality in combat. While similar in design to [[Maul|Darth Maul's]] [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber|double-bladed lightsaber]], the lightsaber used by Marrok and other Inquisitors featured an emitter ring that could rotate the blades around the hilt at a high speed. The former Inquisitor still wielded his red-bladed lightsaber after becoming a mercenary. While dueling with Tano, Marrok switched between the use of his lightsaber's single-blade and the double-blade, and adjusted his fighting style accordingly. He also made use of its design by rotating the blades of his lightsaber during his first and second duel with Tano. In addition, Marrok wore full-body battle armor that completely encased his body, complete with a face-concealing black [[helmet]] and a black [[cape]], which he discarded in battle. By the time of the New Republic Era, the armor had become battered and rusted. [[Marrok's Fiend fighter]] was a [[starfighter]] that the former Inquisitor used as his vehicle during his time as a mercenary in Elsbeth's forces. It was the same [[RP82 Fiend fighter|model]] as [[Shin Hati's Fiend fighter|Shin Hati's Fiend]]. During their attack on Tano's [[T-6 shuttle]] in the Denab system, Marrok piloted his starfighter as a member of Hati's [[squadron]]. ==Behind the scenes== ===Milestones=== Marrok first appeared in "[[Part One: Master and Apprentice]]," the premiere episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]''. Written and directed by [[Dave Filoni]], the episode was released on [[Disney+]] on [[August 22]], [[2023]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-august-2023|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in August 2023}} The character was portrayed by [[Paul Darnell]]. The character's alternate name of "First Brother" was given to an update of Marrok's [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] page in [[November]], [[2024]].{{Databank|marrok-inquisitor|Marrok (Inquisitor)}} {{C|Version archived on November 21, 2024}} The "First Brother" designation was previously given to the [[Eleventh Brother]] Inquisitor{{InsiderCite|229|Inquisitor Countdown}} on [[November 19]] of that year{{DK|url=us/book/9780744098846-star-wars-encyclopedia|text=Star Wars Encyclopedia}} via the reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''. However, [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Leland Chee]] affirmed on [[November 21]] that it had been a mistake in the encyclopedia to call that Inquisitor the First Brother, stating it had come down to a miscommunication.{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2024-11-21|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1309008181808336926|quote=There was miscommunication and we got the number wrong in the Encyclopedia.|archivefile=File:LelandChee-Inquisitor-Discord.png}} The Eleventh Brother's proper designation would be given in the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' article "[[Inquisitor Countdown]]" by [[Amy Richau]] on [[December 10]], 2024{{TitanComics|url=m/171-star-wars-insider-229|text=Star Wars Insider #229}} as part of [[Star Wars Insider 229|issue 229]]. In [[Wikipedia:Matter of Britain|Arthurian legend]], Marrok is the name of a knight who was turned into a werewolf by his wife, who had learned these skills from the witch [[Wikipedia:Morgan Le Fay|Morgan Le Fay]]. In ''Ahsoka'', "[[Morgan Elsbeth|Morgan]]" is the name of Marrok's employer, one of the [[Nightsisters|witches]] of [[Dathomir]]. The wolf motif also ties in with Marrok's fellow [[Dark side of the Force|dark-side]] users [[Shin Hati]] and [[Baylan Skoll]], who share their last names with two wolves from [[Wikipedia:Norse mythology|Norse mythology]].{{WebCite|url=https://nerdist.com/article/every-star-wars-ahsoka-series-reference-to-norse-greek-mythology-arthurian-legend-and-more|text=''Ahsoka'''s Morgan Elsbeth Is Named After Morgan le Fay of Arthurian Legend|author=Walsh, Michael|date=2023-08-28|work=[[Wikipedia:Nerdist|Nerdist]]|quote=The mysterious masked Inquisitor Marrok working for Morgan Elsbeth is ''Ahsoka'''s second major connection to Arthurian legend and myth. In a tale set during "the days of King Arthur," we learn that Sir Marrok was an upstanding Knight until his own wife Irma turned him into a werewolf, seeking to return his lands to their old ways of savagery. And where did Irma learn such skills? From Morgan le Fay. (...) ''Ahsoka'''s former Jedi Knight Baylan Skoll and his apprentice Shin Hati get their names from Norse mythology. Skoll ("One Who Mocks") and Hati ("One Who Hates") are ominous figures in Norse tradition. They're wolves who chase the Sun and Moon in hopes of devouring them.|archivedate=20230831023433}} At [[Celebration Japan (2025)|''Star Wars'' Celebration Japan]] on [[April 18]], [[2025]], Marrok was confirmed to be appearing in the [[2026]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord]]'' through a trailer exclusively shown at the [[Lucasfilm Animation]] panel.{{WebCite|url=https://gizmodo.com/star-wars-maul-shadow-lord-trailer-description-celebration-japan-2000589924|text=''Maul: Shadow Lord'' Is ''Star Wars''{{'s}} Next Animated Series|author=Graves, Sabina|date=2025-04-18|archivedate=20250419181340}} ===Concept art gallery=== {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'' |storyboards= |concept= File:EarlyMarrokConceptArt-Instagram.png|Concept art with belt, Brian Matyas{{Instagram|username=brianmatyas|url=p/DAHTgAiyYvB|name=[[Brian Matyas]]|date=2024-09-19|quote=Marrok concept art featured on the Marvel Ahsoka comics #4 variant cover.
